messages:
zara: FYI premerge SAST smoke on infra PR failed - the keystore probe step errored with KMS AccessDenied when scanner-probe tried to decrypt test blob.

kevin: Saw that, reproducing locally. Log: 
```
ERROR AccessDenied: projects/keystore/keys/ci-fixture-key: permission denied for serviceAccount:scanner-probe@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com
```

ops-bot: Detected IAM change: removed member scanner-probe@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com from roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter in PR infra/5690 (commit 7a1f2b).

zara: Was that change intentional? That probe is the pre-merge guard for all keystore rotations.

kevin: It was intended to tighten scope but the fixture binding was unintentionally excluded. Quick unblock options: ephemeral grant to probe SA, or revert the binding change. Ephemeral looks faster for the build.

sec-bot: Creating audit slice and issuing ephemeral grant requires oncall approval. Audit hint: attach commit id 7a1f2b and PR link.

sec-oncall: Approved ephemeral grant: /grant kms:Decrypt scanner-probe@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com duration=10m audit_id=GNT-595abc. Unblock CI and capture logs.

zara: Re-running the premerge now  probe passed, SAST smoke continues. Adding a failing test to infra repo so future PRs that touch keystore IAM will run the probe.

kevin: I'll open infra/PR-5701 to (1) re-add a narrowly-scoped fixture binding, (2) add the keystore-smoke GitHub Action, and (3) update the rollout checklist to require consumer smoke runs. Linking ticket SEC-4102.

sec-oncall: Closing the immediate blocker. SEC-4102 should track the durable fixes and the audit evidence. If the grant record is missing or this recurs, escalate to sec oncall.
